All images in this directory are synthetic test artwork generated by
`generate.js`. They contain no user images, screenshots, fonts, or downloaded
assets. The generator uses the development-only `@napi-rs/canvas` dependency
and Node's built-in DEFLATE implementation; it does not launch a browser.

Regenerate from the project root:

```sh
node test/fixtures/image-equivalence/generate.js
```

The source is a deterministic 384 × 288 illustration. Variants exercise PNG
recompression with identical pixels, JPEG/WebP quality 85, half-size previews,
very small previews, rotation, mirroring, and cropping. `different.png` is a
different synthetic image at the same dimensions. The two white-background
fixtures differ only in a visibly changed 24 × 24 colored square, so a large
matching background cannot conceal a local content change. Alpha fixtures
exercise transparent pixels flattened onto white or an incorrect black matte.

Fixtures are committed so a normal test run performs real decoding without
regenerating codec output. Codec upgrades may change encoded bytes; review
and regenerate explicitly when updating that dependency.
